completed_tasks.name: Implement PageIndex schema and clinical reasoning tree generation
completed_tasks.notes: Decided against auto-generating trees from existing data sources: SFT medical dialogue data is Simplified Chinese TCM diagnosis Q&A (wrong language, wrong domain), and service_items payment_rules are generic coverage boilerplate with no clinical steps. Instead hand-wrote 4 more high-quality Traditional Chinese PageIndex trees (electrowave facelift, HA filler, fractional laser, HIFU lifting) alongside the existing 2 (laser resurfacing, botox), covering different anesthesia/downtime profiles as a quality baseline for TASK-004's LLM prompt. All 6 verified clean of price leakage and Simplified Chinese. Also found and fixed page_index_fts, which was still on unicode61 tokenizer from before the TASK-001 trigram migration — new trees were completely unsearchable until fixed; now all three FTS5 tables (drugs_fts, service_items_fts, page_index_fts) consistently use trigram.

completed_tasks.name: page_index_trees incremental update support + content versioning
completed_tasks.notes: Added content_version (increments on real content change), source_type (manual/llm_generated/clinic_upload), needs_regeneration (for future nightly batch to pick stale rows). seed_trees.py rewritten from INSERT OR REPLACE (wholesale overwrite, reset created_at every run) to true incremental UPSERT — compares existing content, skips if unchanged, updates + bumps content_version + preserves created_at if changed. Removed the duplicate create_sample_page_index() from scripts/seed_database.py (2 trees migrated into seed_trees.py's TREES list) so page_index_trees seeding has one single source of truth. Verified all three states (insert/skip-unchanged/update-with-version-bump) work correctly and FTS5 search still matches after updates. updated_at intentionally NOT trigger-maintained (avoids recursive UPDATE-trigger-updates-self risk) — application code must pass CURRENT_TIMESTAMP explicitly on updates.

completed_tasks.name: Vision expansion planning + entry-point docs for future sessions
completed_tasks.notes: User described a larger vision beyond the original 8-task phase: (1) general medical Q&A entry point for anonymous late-night self-queries, (2) clinic-uploadable PDF/JPEG/PNG with OCR ingestion into PageIndex, (3) local LLM with cloud API fallback, (4) nightly batch to pre-generate common Q&A (reduce daytime token cost) plus nightly knowledge-base maintenance, (5) doctor-toolbox.com official API integration (bidirectional import/export) after clinicbrain's own features are done. Investigated the user's prior project DrtoolboxLocalServer (same clinic, github.com/hsuyungfeng/DrtoolboxLocalServer, also present locally under ~/Desktop/DrtoolBox/UpdateList/MedicalOderUpdate/) — it already implements most of this: pytesseract OCR with chi_tra language pack (4 duplicated call sites — a mistake not to repeat), ChromaDB vector search alongside FTS5, local llama.cpp inference (Ornith models, dual-GPU), identical page_index_trees column structure, same pricing-masking rules almost verbatim. Wrote .planning/VISION-EXPANSION.md (full gap analysis, decision log, phase 02-05 draft sequencing) and root-level Plan.md (single entry point for future LLM sessions) + AGENTS.md (binding project rules, modeled on DrtoolboxLocalServer's AGENTS.md).

completed_tasks.name: Build clinical reasoning tree LLM prompt
completed_tasks.notes: Built src/pageindex/prompt_template.py: build_prompt() assembles the generation prompt using 2 of the 6 hand-written trees as few-shot examples; generate_tree() takes a provider-agnostic llm_call: Callable[[str], str] so Phase 02's actual local-LLM client can be plugged in later without touching this code; parse_and_validate() enforces Traditional-Chinese-only, no price leakage, no overclaiming language (保證有效 etc.), all 5 required fields present, tolerates markdown code-fence-wrapped output. Also extracted the UPSERT logic that used to live only inside seed_trees.py into a new shared src/pageindex/db_writer.py (upsert_trees(conn, trees, source_type)) so both manual seeding and LLM generation write through the exact same incremental-upsert path — prevents repeating the TASK-003 mistake where seed_database.py and seed_trees.py each maintained a duplicate copy of the same 2 trees. Tested 7 validator scenarios (valid output, price leak, simplified Chinese, missing fields, overclaiming language, code-fence tolerance, malformed JSON) plus a full generate→validate→upsert→FTS5-search round trip against a scratch copy of clinic.db (not the real one). No real LLM available in this environment yet (no ollama/openai/anthropic client installed) — the prompt/validator were built and tested with a fake llm_call; actual model output quality is unverified until Phase 02 wires up a real local LLM.

completed_tasks.name: Implement search/query interface with routing
completed_tasks.notes: Built src/query/search.py (unified FTS5 trigram-vs-LIKE dispatch across drugs/service_items/page_index_trees, confirmed working correctly against page_index_trees despite its content_rowid='id' quirk) and src/query/router.py (classify() for special/general routing by keyword, mask_prices() as the final CONSTRAINT enforcement layer, handle_query() as the unified entry point). Found and fixed a real bug during testing: FTS5 trigram MATCH requires the whole query string to match contiguously, so passing a full natural-language question (e.g. '音波拉提會痛嗎？') straight to MATCH returns zero hits even though '音波拉提' exists in the data. Built extract_search_terms() to solve this — combines route-keyword hits with CJK-character-run extraction, split on common question-particle patterns (是什麼/多久/怎麼/etc.) as cut points, sorted longest-first to prioritize specificity, deduped. Verified against realistic full-sentence queries; the only remaining known imprecision is that generic 2-char words (e.g. 維持, appearing in most PageIndex summary_text values) can add noise to LIKE-fallback results, though longer/more-specific terms are tried first so the correct answer is usually still ranked first. general route currently returns zero page_index_trees hits for any query since all 6 seed trees are category='special' — this is expected, not a bug; general-category content doesn't exist until Phase 04's nightly batch generation produces some. No formal test file was added — TASK-008 (evaluation suite) is the designated place for building out regression tests covering the scenarios found here (full-sentence FTS failures, stopword-splitting, keyword-vs-CJK-fragment precision).

completed_tasks.name: Build OTC drug localization layer
completed_tasks.notes: First task in this project executed by an external tool (Antigravity) against a detailed written spec (.planning/phases/01-taiwan-pageindex-rag/TASK-006-PLAN.md), then independently re-verified by Claude before committing — not just trusting the delivery report. Added src/db/otc_mappings.json (68 ingredient mappings with alias support, replacing the 14-entry hardcoded dict in scripts/seed_database.py). update_otc_names() now reads the JSON; function signature and main() call site unchanged. src/query/search.py gained format_drug_display_name() + a display_name field auto-attached to search_drugs() results (verified it still passes through router.py's existing mask_prices() sweep, not bypassing it). src/query/router.py's stopword-split list gained common conjunctions (或/和/跟/有等) to handle compound colloquial questions like '請問有普拿疼或消炎止痛藥嗎？' — re-ran all 6 of TASK-005's prior test cases and got byte-identical results, no regression. Verified independently (re-ran everything myself, did not trust the delivery report's numbers as-is): coverage 456/7,573 (6.02%) → 2,484/7,573 (32.8%); full reseed completes in 1.7s with no errors; all 68 mapping entries clean of price leakage and Simplified Chinese; diff scope stayed within the 4 files the plan allowed. Found one inaccuracy in the delivery report worth flagging: it cited PARACETAMOL matching 3 records as proof the ACETAMINOPHEN/PARACETAMOL alias fix worked, but I verified there are zero drugs in this dataset that contain PARACETAMOL without also containing ACETAMINOPHEN — that specific case would have matched under the old logic too, alias or not. However I separately confirmed the alias mechanism itself is real and working: ASPIRIN/ACETYLSALICYLIC ACID recovered 1 additional record and MAGNESIUM HYDROXIDE/MAGNESIUM OXIDE recovered 12, so the feature works, just the report's chosen example didn't actually demonstrate it.

decisions.decision: Use dual-layer architecture: General NHI data + Clinic-specific data
decisions.rationale: Separates concerns and allows independent updates

decisions.decision: Implement route-based context gathering (special vs general)
decisions.rationale: Prevents information overload and ensures clinic-specific data doesn't leak

decisions.decision: Absolute price masking rule for all outputs
decisions.rationale: Taiwan medical compliance prohibits any price information in AI outputs

decisions.decision: Local LLM inference is the default, cloud API is fallback-only

decisions.decision: Nightly batch job does both: (1) pre-generate common Q&A pairs via LLM into a cache table, (2) maintain/rebuild PageIndex trees and re-index new documents

decisions.rationale: User explicitly asked to prioritize this — an updatable database design is a prerequisite for reducing future token usage (query DB first, only call LLM for what's missing/stale)

decisions.rationale: User explicitly rejected the MITM pattern when asked to clarify; wants a proper API contract instead. Scheduled after clinicbrain's own phases (01-04) are complete.
